exophase.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades)

own-words.label: Guide notes — written for this entry from the official description; not yet verified in the game

psnprofiles.label: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PSN progress counts)

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself: earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops. Work the roadmap in order — story, side missions, counts, activities, heists — and let this be the last one you chase, not the first. The header above shows how many are left; anything still unticked is what stands between you and it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The first trophy most players earn: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. The story takes you straight through it, so just play the opening and it pops when the mission ends. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to find first.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the opening mission, Gone Fishing — finish it on your first pass.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapters complete as the story moves on, so keep playing the main missions and this unlocks at the chapter's end. No side requirement, no collectible — the main path alone does it.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Chapter 1 — earn it before the story moves past the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same rule as the other chapter trophies: main missions only, no collectibles needed. If you are mopping up after the story, replay the chapter's missions until the chapter completes.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Chapter 2 — earn it before the story moves past the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep to the main missions and this unlocks at the chapter's end. It is the midpoint marker of the story, so if you have it, you are halfway to the finale.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Chapter 3 — earn it before the story moves past the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Main missions only; when the chapter's final mission ends, the trophy pops. After this one, only the final mission stands between you and the gold.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Chapter 4 — earn it before the story moves into the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the story's last beat: play the finale through to its end and the gold pops with the credits. Do the finale on your first pass — it is the trophy the whole roadmap builds toward, and the only gold in the story set.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the final mission — the story's last beat.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock when the mission completes, so finish Breakfast Run and this is yours. If it does not pop, replay the mission.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the mission Breakfast Run — finish it on your first pass.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set-pieces of the story: play it through, survive the getaway, and the trophy unlocks at the mission's end.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the mission The Cartel Heist — finish it on your first pass.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at the end screen. It belongs to the story's middle stretch, so it should land naturally while you play the chapters in order.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the mission Child's Play — finish it on your first pass.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at the end screen. Headliners sits among the story's named missions, so it lands while you play the chapters in order — no side work needed.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the mission Headliners — finish it on your first pass.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The airport is the setting, so expect a loud, open fight: finish the takedown and the trophy pops. Keep moving, use cover, and let the mission's own checkpoints carry you through.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the mission VCIA Takedown — finish it on your first pass.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The name promises a big operation, and the trophy asks only that you finish it — play the mission through to its end screen and it is yours.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the mission Operation Savage Glory — finish it on your first pass.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the real grind behind the platinum. Every mission, strand, collectible and activity the game counts toward 100% feeds this one. Use this checklist as your map: when every other trophy is ticked, check the in-game completion figure, and the last few percent are usually a collectible set or an activity you have not tried. Leave this to the very end of the roadmap.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime the game scores as you drive and ride, and they add up across the whole game — so drive fast and take the jumps whenever you see them. Use the counter on this trophy to log your progress; long sessions of stunt-heavy driving are the fastest way to 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game has a set of activity types — races, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade and the rest — and this pops when you have sampled one of each. Work through the activities in Stage 4 of the roadmap; a single visit to each type is enough, so a first try counts everywhere.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Every one of the 42 needs a gold medal, so treat it as a skill grind: learn each challenge's scoring, then gold them one by one, using the counter here to track how many you have golded. This is the hardest silver in the set — save it for when your aim is warm.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Drone races run at several spots around Leonida, and you need a win at each one — a win at a location you have already won does not count twice. Learn each course's line, then win them one location at a time.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty distinct race events, not twenty wins in the same one — work through the race list and tick each new win off. Street races and any other race type the game offers all count toward the twenty, as long as each event is a different one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take his fishing challenge, and out-fish him. Fishing is timing and patience: watch the line, strike when the game tells you to, and keep Cal's score in view. It pops the moment you beat his score.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to its end. Any arcade game counts — pick the shortest one you enjoy and finish it. A quick, easy bronze for Stage 4.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission line ends with one last job — finish it and the trophy pops. Side-mission finales are easy to leave until later, but do them while the story is still open; they belong to one contact's storyline, which is why this guide flags them missable.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Andy's final mission — finish his storyline before the story ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's line ends with one last job — finish it and the trophy pops. Do the contact finales in Stage 2 of the roadmap, while their storylines are still open.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Kenton's final mission — finish his storyline before the story ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's line ends with one last job — finish it and the trophy pops. Contact finales are the backbone of Stage 2: clear them all and five trophies land in one sweep.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Billy's final mission — finish his storyline before the story ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers hand out short mission chains all over the map, and eight full strands is the ask. Roam, watch for stranger markers, and finish each chain you start; the counter here tracks the strands you complete. These stay open after the story, so they are not flagged missable.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's line ends with one last job — finish it and the trophy pops. Clear the contact finales together in Stage 2 so none of them is left behind.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Randy's final mission — finish his storyline before the story ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's line ends with one last job — finish it and the trophy pops. With Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, this is the last of the five contact finales.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Tyrone's final mission — finish his storyline before the story ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the state — find each one and meditate there. This is a pure exploration trophy: roam the map, and use the note box on this trophy to jot down spots you have already visited so you do not double back.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret wants one specific animal — track it, hunt it, and bring the hunt home. Unique hunts are usually about patience and the right ground, so follow Bret's lead on where the animal roams. The exact animal and ground have not been verified in the game yet — the description is the whole brief.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in sets — finish any three full sets and the silver pops. Collecting is a long roam: pick up cards as you find them, and use the note box here to record which sets you have finished.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. One hundred spots to WAiNK at — a long count, so chip away at it whenever you pass a new location rather than saving all 100 for the end. The counter on this trophy is your tally; every new location you WAiNK at moves it one closer.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game tracks fifty challenges across its systems — stunts, races, shooting and more all feed the count. Just play broadly and the number climbs; the counter here tracks your total toward fifty.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and escape. Plan it: a fast car, open road, and no police in sight when the stars drop. This is a setup, not an accident — arrange it deliberately.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner with you at four stars — a setup you have to arrange, not something that happens by accident.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three shops in a row, partner with you, wanted level intact throughout. Pick three shops close together, plan the route, and keep the heat off between robberies. One continuous run of three — if the run breaks, start it again.
trophies.missableNote: One continuous run of three shops — if the wanted level drops or the run breaks, start again.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or find one hundred different vehicles — variety is the point, so try everything you pass instead of sticking to one favourite car. The counter here tracks your discoveries toward 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in reach and drop all five before it ends. Set it up first: draw a group together, then activate. All five must fall inside one use — a miss means setting the scene again.
trophies.missableNote: All five must fall inside one Combat Focus — a miss means setting the scene again.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport by a route the game did not schedule — the description is the whole clue, and the exact exit has not been verified in the game yet. Try the airport's edges and service routes rather than the main exit, and if one attempt fails, leave and try a different way out.
trophies.missableNote: A one-time departure — if the attempt fails, leave and try a different way out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks, and this one is about handling the heat they bring — the description gives no more than the joke, so the exact trigger has not been verified in the game yet. Expect a wanted-level fight with armour on the streets, and take it when the tanks roll in.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to a Rhino encounter — take it when the tanks roll in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in, take the goods, get out — and never trip the alarm or a witness. Go quiet: watch patrols, move when the coast is clear, and leave before anyone raises it. One clean run — being spotted voids the attempt.
trophies.missableNote: One clean run — being spotted voids the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five clean getaways. Vault robberies are the big heists of free roam — plan each one, and escape cleanly after each. The counter here tracks vaults robbed and escaped.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and get away clean. Trucks run set routes — watch for one, strike, and lose the heat before the trophy counts it.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of the state until the map is filled in. This is the explorer's trophy: roam everywhere, and use the note box here to record the corners you have not reached yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs illegal operations — rob one belonging to each of them. Work through the gangs one by one; the trophy pops when the last gang's operation is hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. A quiet moment trophy — it pops when the scene plays out. If the prompt does not appear, come back and try again.
trophies.missableNote: A single scripted moment on Ocean Beach — if the prompt does not appear, come back and try again.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car and drive it straight out through the showroom — the classic way, not the door. One smash-out; if the showroom does not break right, reset and run it again.
trophies.missableNote: One smash-out — if the showroom does not break right, reset and run it again.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through — the trophy is about the act, not the score. It is tied to that one alley, so bowl there.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the Kolt & Associates alley — bowl there.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A story moment about the partnership — the description is deliberately vague, and the exact trigger has not been verified in the game yet. Play the story and it should come with the partnership's big moment; do not skip the partnership scenes.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to a story beat — do not skip the partnership scenes.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The story asks you to choose, and this trophy tracks those choices — PSN counts them, and the total is large. Make choices as they come rather than avoiding them; a choice skipped is a choice not counted.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to story choices — a choice skipped is a choice not counted.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail once, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is about the comeback. The exact event has not been verified in the game yet; the description's hint is that the second attempt is the one that counts. Do not reload the failure away.
trophies.missableNote: Needs a failed first attempt followed by a success — do not reload the failure away.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — witness it. The description is the whole clue and the event has not been verified in the game yet; keep an eye out for the odd and the unexplained while you roam the map's strange corners.
trophies.missableNote: A single strange event — if you miss it, keep roaming the odd corners of the map.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by with a melee weapon — knock someone down from a moving vehicle without a gun. Slow the car, line it up, swing. A single move: melee, from a vehicle, on the move.
trophies.missableNote: A single move — melee, from a vehicle, on the move.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until a quarter of a million is clean. It adds up across the game — keep robbing, keep laundering — and the counter here tracks your total.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. A hundred thousand dollars of shopping — clothes, gear, whatever the shops sell. Spend as you go and it arrives on its own; the counter here tracks your total toward $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market. Garages are the collector's home base — save up, buy them one by one, and the trophy pops with the last deed.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Ten vehicles registered in the Scooter Bros app — find them, register them, and the count climbs. The counter here tracks your registrations toward ten.
trophies.name: On the Spot
